newsitem.title: USA: OM sees product sales staying strong in 97.
newsitem.headline: OM sees product sales staying strong in 97.

text.p: OM Group Inc Thursday said its marketing efforts resulted in strong product sales throughout 1996 and expects sales of OMG products to remain strong in 1997.

"We are well-positioned for continued growth in 1997," said James Mooney, OMG's chairman and chief executive officer. "In addition, our acquisition of SCM Metals in January of 1997 offers us significant growth opportunities -- both through geographic expansion and new product development."

The company earlier reported net income for the year ended December 31, 1996, increased 16 percent, to $30.0 million, or $1.56 per share, from $25.9 million, or $1.36 per share, reported in 1995. Net sales were $388 million, a 7.5 percent increase from 1995's net sales of $361 million.
